title: Common Sense Investing w/ Joel Greenblatt
summary: Joel is the managing director and Co-CIO of Gotham Capital, which has produced spectacular returns for over 3 decades. He is also the author of investing classics like The Little Book that Beats the Market, and You Can Be a Stock Market Genius. On top of that, he is a professor at Columbia University, where he teaches value investing to MBA students.
